objective: Restore v0.5.0 release evidence without duplicating the multi-gigabyte validation artifact on the runner filesystem.

baseline.status: v0.5.0 Release workflow failed while restoring validated scientific evidence because the workflow duplicated a ~3.77 GB artifact with cp -a.

correctness.after: validated evidence tree is restored by move without a second full copy

reliability.before: Release run 336 failed at Restore validated scientific evidence
reliability.after: release workflow can proceed to package build and publication

reproducibility.before: validated evidence existed only in workflow artifact
reproducibility.after: same evidence tree is restored into the expected workspace path without scientific transformation

evidence: Process/release automation change only; scientific validation contracts and release-gate semantics are unchanged.

root_causes: Release workflow used cp -a to duplicate the ~3.77 GB validated scientific evidence tree, exhausting runner disk during restoration.

findings: Large validated evidence artifacts must be moved or restored without unnecessary second copies when runner disk capacity is constrained.

open_blockers: PR-147 CI and release workflow rerun must pass.
